preconditions.description: The size of the array is between 1 and 50, inclusive.
Each element in the array is between 1 and 1,000,000, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
Each query contains an integer K between 1 and 1,000,000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == count_of_subarrays(A, K[i]) for all i
postconditions.description: For each query, the output must be the number of subarrays where the minimum of the subarray is equal to K.
